Degrees & Programs

At Antioch University, we believe education is the foundation for change, empowerment, and equality. Whether you're aiming to deepen your teaching expertise, step into educational leadership, or champion systemic change, Antioch’s programs equip you with the knowledge, tools, and support to succeed.

browse all programs

Commitment to Social Justice & Equity

Grounded in a commitment to our mission, students learn to create transformative learning environments that challenge inequities and empower diverse student populations.

Practitioner-Focused Learning

Designed for educators by educators, with a focus on real-world application. Students are equipped with actionable strategies and tools whether you're teaching, leading, or advocating for educational reform.

Flexible Learning Options

Tailored program structures, including online, hybrid, and low-residency options, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life while pursuing your advanced degree.

A Doctorate of Changemakers

Antioch’s EdD and PhD programs are designed for practitioners committed to social action. Develop skills needed to lead transformative change in educational institutions, advocate for policy reform, and inspire the next generation of educators and leaders.

Fostering Inclusive Learning Environments

Advance your career and amplify your impact with an Education degree from Antioch University. Join a community of educators, leaders, and innovators committed to creating equitable and transformative learning environments. Start your journey toward shaping the future of education today.
